channel.description: Straight answers about mobile diesel delivery in Denver: dyed vs. clear diesel rules, DEF, generator refueling, costs, and emergency fuel service.

item.title: How Much Does Mobile Diesel Delivery Cost in Denver?
item.description: Most Denver mobile diesel deliveries are priced as the day's market rate per gallon plus a delivery fee. Recent delivered ranges: $3.69-$4.69/gal for on-road diesel and $3.09-$4.09/gal for off-road (dyed) diesel, with delivery fees from $0 to around $1,000 depending on volume, distance, and site difficulty. Emergency calls roughly double the delivery fee.
